mapper.select: SELECT id, name, asset_code, category, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiration, location, quantity, available_quantity, max_rental_quantity, is_rentable, is_retired, managed_by, status, description, image_path, created_at, updated_at FROM equipment

SELECT id, name, asset_code, category, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiration, location, quantity, available_quantity, max_rental_quantity, is_rentable, is_retired, managed_by, status, description, image_path, created_at, updated_at FROM equipment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO equipment ( name, asset_code, category, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiration, location, quantity, available_quantity, max_rental_quantity, is_rentable, is_retired, managed_by, status, description, image_path ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{assetCode}, #{category}, #{manufacturer}, #{purchaseDate}, #{warrantyExpiration}, #{location}, #{quantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{maxRentalQuantity}, #{isRentable}, #{isRetired}, #{managedBy}, #{status}, #{description}, #{imagePath} )
mapper.update: UPDATE equipment SET name = #{name}, asset_code = #{assetCode}, category = #{category}, manufacturer = #{manufacturer}, purchase_date = #{purchaseDate}, warranty_expiration = #{warrantyExpiration}, location = #{location}, quantity = #{quantity}, available_quantity = #{availableQuantity}, max_rental_quantity = #{maxRentalQuantity}, is_rentable = #{isRentable}, is_retired = #{isRetired}, managed_by = #{managedBy}, status = #{status}, description = #{description}, image_path = #{imagePath}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE equipment SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, asset_code, category, manufacturer, purchase_date, warranty_expiration, location, quantity, available_quantity, max_rental_quantity, is_rentable, is_retired, managed_by, status, description, image_path, created_at, updated_at FROM equipment WHERE (is_retired = false OR is_retired IS NULL) ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
